reason: S1 adds the externally declared experimental entry point meshopt_generateNormals, but H0 never calls it, so H0 cannot reach its new normal-generation logic or exercise its distinct indexed/unindexed, count, stride, position, output-buffer, and crease-angle inputs. The gap is commit-induced because the declaration and implementation are absent from S0 and introduced in S1.
evidence: src/tangentspace.cpp adds meshopt_generateNormals and the new helper computeFaceNormals.

meshopt_generateNormals accepts indices, index_count, vertex_positions, vertex_count, vertex_positions_stride, crease_angle, and a caller-provided result buffer, including the indices==NULL mode enforced by assert(indices || index_count == vertex_count).
H0 calls meshlet building, codec, simplification, and partitioning APIs, but contains no call to meshopt_generateNormals; therefore none of its input bytes reach this new entry point.
recommended_action: Extend a mesh-oriented harness to invoke meshopt_generateNormals with fuzz-controlled valid triangle data, indexed and indices==NULL modes, supported vertex_positions_stride values, varied vertex/index counts and crease_angle values, and a correctly sized result buffer of index_count*3 floats.
